## Discovery & Translational Science

- **Macrophage-derived VEGFA regulates intraocular pressure in aging** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.20.746006)
  - Single-cell RNA sequencing and imaging in mouse models and human tissue identified an age-associated accumulation of peri-Schlemm's canal macrophages that express VEGFA to maintain aqueous humor outflow.
  - Conditional deletion of *Vegfa* in CX3CR1⁺ macrophages elevated intraocular pressure and reduced outflow facility in 9-month-old mice, highlighting a novel homeostatic mechanism relevant to open-angle glaucoma.

- **Cytoplasmic sequestration of menin drives non-MEN1 prolactinoma pathology** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.19.745771)
  - In mouse models and human biopsies of sporadic prolactinomas, total *MEN1* transcript levels were unaltered, but menin protein was excluded from the nucleus and localized exclusively in the cytoplasm.
  - This functional nuclear loss led to suppressed p27 and PTEN expression, increased cyclin D1 expression, and enhanced pAKT signaling in tumoral lactotrophs.

- **Early pirfenidone treatment mitigates post-spinal cord injury bladder dysfunction** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.19.745817)
  - Administration of oral pirfenidone immediately following contusive spinal cord injury in mice attenuated acute transcriptomic activation of TNF-α, IL-6, complement cascade, and TGF-β pathways.
  - Early anti-inflammatory and anti-fibrotic intervention reduced tissue hypertrophy and neutrophil infiltration while improving long-term voiding function.

- **Causal machine learning links GLP-1 receptor agonists to reduced Alzheimer's risk in type 2 diabetes** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.21.26361012)
  - A target trial emulation using electronic health records from the All of Us cohort in adults aged ≥55 with type 2 diabetes demonstrated that initiating a GLP-1 receptor agonist prolonged 48-month dementia-free survival compared to sulfonylureas.

- **Serum uric acid levels correlate with ixekizumab response in psoriasis** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42637676/)
  - A multicenter prospective cohort study in China identified significant associations between baseline serum uric acid concentrations, circulating inflammatory protein profiles, and clinical response to the anti-IL-17A monoclonal antibody ixekizumab.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

- **MBP134 antibody cocktail demonstrates efficacy in Bundibugyo ebolavirus treatment and post-exposure prophylaxis** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04663-5)
  - A case report documented complete recovery of a patient with severe Bundibugyo virus disease treated with emergency-use monoclonal antibody cocktail MBP134 in combination with remdesivir, leading to discharge at day 22.
  - A companion report showed that post-exposure prophylaxis with MBP134 was well tolerated and prevented clinical disease in an adult and four pediatric individuals following high-to-intermediate exposure risk ([Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04664-4)).

- **SinocaRT trial protocol establishes Phase 2 dose-painting radiotherapy design** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42637259/)
  - A published study protocol details the SinocaRT randomized Phase 2 trial evaluating dose-painting radiotherapy following multi-block endoscopic endonasal surgery in sinonasal tumors.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

- **Phase 3 ConCERT trial evaluates weekly vs. tri-weekly cisplatin in head and neck cancer** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42636269/)
  - Results from the randomized Phase 3 noninferiority ConCERT trial evaluated weekly versus every-3-week cisplatin administered concurrently with external beam radiation therapy in patients with locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

- **RAPID-POP trial compares stenting protocols during primary PCI** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42637295/)
  - The prospective RAPID-POP trial evaluated procedural safety and efficacy outcomes comparing rapid inflation-deflation against pressure-optimized stenting in patients undergoing primary percutaneous coronary intervention.

## Regulatory & Approvals

- **[Biotech]** **FDA places clinical hold on Regenxbio's RGX-121 gene therapy** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/regenxbio-fda-hunter-syndrome-hold-mri-safety/828578/)
  - The FDA placed a clinical hold on RGX-121 (an AAV gene therapy for Hunter syndrome / MPS II) after routine MRI scans revealed asymptomatic, likely benign spinal masses in five participants treated 3 to 6 years ago.
  - Patients remain clinically stable, but Regenxbio has deferred near-term plans to resubmit its BLA, which previously received a complete response letter in February.

- **[Biotech]** **FDA extends review of Capricor's deramiocel by three months** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/capricor-fda-gsk-hibsago-ambros-werewolf-united-ralinepag/828560/)
  - The FDA extended the PDUFA action date for Capricor Therapeutics' deramiocel cell therapy from August 22 to November 22, 2026, after the company submitted updated follow-up data supporting a refined indication for upper limb function in Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
  - The agency designated the supplemental submission a major amendment following an advisory committee vote that questioned efficacy in DMD cardiomyopathy while expressing support for upper limb functional outcomes.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Japan approves GSK and Ionis's Hibsago for chronic hepatitis B** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/capricor-fda-gsk-hibsago-ambros-werewolf-united-ralinepag/828560/)
  - Japanese health regulators approved Hibsago, an antisense oligonucleotide co-developed by GSK and Ionis Pharmaceuticals, for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B infection.

- **[Biotech]** **Rhythm Pharmaceuticals gains Japanese approval for Imcivree in hypothalamic obesity** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2091858837611462785)
  - Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW) granted marketing authorization for Imcivree (setmelanotide) to treat acquired hypothalamic obesity, with commercial launch expected by year-end.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly launches oral weight-loss drug Foundayo in the UK** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2091854983989690655)
  - Eli Lilly launched its oral non-peptide GLP-1 receptor agonist Foundayo (orforglipron) in the United Kingdom.

- **[Biotech]** **Erasca receives FDA Fast Track designation for ERAS-0015** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2091859012455203326)
  - The FDA granted Fast Track status to ERAS-0015, an oral RAS pathway inhibitor, for the treatment of metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

- **[Biotech]** **Spruce Biosciences confirms Q4 BLA submission for TA-ERT** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2091858420512989539)
  - Spruce Biosciences reported positive pre-BLA alignment with the FDA, keeping its planned BLA filing for TA-ERT on track for Q4 2026.

- **FDA preparing regulatory guidance for generative AI in medical software** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/24/fda-rick-abramson-generative-ai-guidances-are-coming/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - FDA Digital Health Policy Chief Rick Abramson stated the agency plans to issue formal regulatory guidance governing generative AI devices and clinical decision-support tools.

## Business & Strategy

- **[Big Pharma]** **Roche licenses Hanmi's muscle-sparing obesity candidate in $2.5B agreement** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/roche-lean-mass-preservation-hanmi-obesity-deal/828579/)
  - Roche acquired exclusive global rights (ex-South Korea) to Hanmi Pharm's HM17321, an investigational urocortin 2 analog designed to drive weight loss while preserving lean muscle mass.
  - Roche will pay $190 million upfront and up to $2.3 billion in development, regulatory, and commercial milestones, assuming clinical development after Hanmi completes an ongoing Phase 1 trial.

- **[Biotech]** **Cellares lays off 100 employees following lost pharma partnership** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/cellares-layoffs-cell-therapy-manufacturing/828588/)
  - Cell therapy CDMO Cellares announced a 100-person workforce reduction triggered by the termination of a deal with an undisclosed partner, coming two months after closing a $327 million Series D round.
  - Automated manufacturing collaborations with Bristol Myers Squibb, Sonoma Biotherapeutics, and Cabaletta Bio remain operational.

- **MassBio report highlights growing seed-to-Series A funding gap and rising Chinese R&D volume** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/massbio-industry-biotech-vc-ipo-funding-licensing/828621/)
  - Massachusetts biotechs raised $3.5 billion in VC funding in H1 2026 (+25% YoY), but early-stage financing diverged: average seed totals fell to $4.65 million while average Series A rounds reached $80 million.
  - China's drug development pipeline expanded 36.2% YoY to surpass Europe for the first time, while U.S. pipeline volume remained flat.

## Public Health & Policy

- **FTC challenges drugmaker patent strategies while Medicaid obesity coverage stalls** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/24/biotech-news-lady-gaga-and-her-fiance-launch-biotech-startup/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - The FTC initiated legal challenges against Amgen's Enbrel patent enforcement strategies as part of an expanding federal review of pharmaceutical patent thickets.
  - State Medicaid programs continue to resist mandatory coverage for high-cost GLP-1 weight-loss therapeutics due to budget constraints ([STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/08/24/state-medicaid-obesity-drugs-regenxbio-gene-therapy/?utm_campaign=rss)).

- Biology & Health
    - [Surprising Results of Omega-3 Fats - 45 Studies](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eBUkNFZw_Q8) -- Physionic
        - Evaluates 45 scientific studies examining the cognitive effects of omega-3 fatty acid supplementation across various trial populations.
        - Differentiates cognitive outcomes based on baseline mental status, contrasting results in cognitively impaired individuals against cognitively healthy controls.
        - Analyzes key mediating variables in the literature, including the chemical form of omega-3, baseline omega-3 index levels, potential adverse effects or harms, and optimal implementation strategies.
- Pure Science
    - [It's impossible to choose a number at random](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/5U-V0y-fkSw) -- Veritasium
        - Explains that mathematical formulas are deterministic and consistently yield identical outputs, making true mathematical randomness impossible to generate via formulas.
        - Highlights the foundational challenge of choosing or isolating elements within mathematical systems without relying on genuine random selection.
        - Questions how alternative mathematical and computational selection techniques function when deterministic constraints prevent true random choice.
